verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers free public tools like Document Driver (corp/LLC formation docs), Capital/Liquidation Calculators, and build guides covering Form/Finance sections including SAFEs, all without requiring client status. However, evidence does not confirm free downloadable NDA templates or actual term sheet documents, and formation guide explicitly advises consulting legal advisors before use, suggesting limited self-serve completeness. Missing for 10: explicit NDA template/download evidence, confirmation of full SAFE/term sheet document generation (only financing guide narrative shown), and independent verification of tool functionality.
